lines.targetText: We need to talk about a weekly board.

lines.targetText: In my opinion, I suggest a simple weekly board.

lines.arabicTranslation: في رأيي، I suggest a simple weekly board.

lines.targetText: Because it makes the plan visible.

lines.arabicTranslation: لأن it makes the plan visible.

lines.targetText: I suggest that we should test it for one week.

lines.targetText: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.

lines.pronunciation: Thank you. I will explain it to the team.
